desc: Ideation complete: Analyzed problem and determined O(n log n) solution using Segment Tree for range max subarray sum queries.
Implement a segment tree that supports range max subarray sum queries.
Precompute the positions of each unique element in the array.
Compute the initial answer as the max subarray sum of the entire array.
For each unique element, determine the segments created by removing all its occurrences.
For each segment, query the segment tree for the max subarray sum and update the global maximum.
